parse_attr_list: parse an attribute list string and return a list of attribute key-value tuples
parse_attr_list_with_remainder: parse an attribute list string and return attribute tuples plus any remaining text after a closing brace
check_element_is_header: check if an XML element is a header tag from h1 through h6
assign_attrs_to_element: assign parsed attributes to an XML element including class additions and sanitized names
sanitize_xml_name: sanitize an attribute name to conform to XML NCName rules by replacing invalid characters with underscores
